verdict.rationale: Morph documents its own first-party MCP server in a dedicated guide. The guide connects AI tools such as Claude Code to Morph's fast file editing and exposes named tools like `codebase_search` and `github_codebase_search`, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, documented setup/auth/transport details in the evidence.
